verses.gurmukhi: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥ ਜਉ ਗਰਬੈ ਬਹੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਿਤੰਤਰਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿੰਧ ਸੋਭ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: savaiyaa || jau garabai bahu boo(n)dh chita(n)tar sanamukh si(n)dh sobh nahee paavai ||

en.bdb: Savaiya   If a drop of water feels proud of its greatness in its mind, it does not earn a good name or praise before the vast ocean.
